name: Lark CLI
description: Gives humans and coding agents an official CLI and bundled skills for Lark and Feishu messaging, docs, Base, sheets, calendar, mail, and tasks, with OAuth login and raw API access.

skills.name: Lark Messenger
skills.description: Sends and replies to messages, manages group chats, searches message history, and uploads or downloads images and files in Lark.

skills.name: Calendar Scheduling
skills.description: Views the agenda, creates and updates events, checks free/busy and time suggestions, finds meeting rooms, and replies to invitations.

skills.name: Docs And Base
skills.description: Creates, reads, updates, and searches Markdown-based documents, and manages Base tables, fields, records, views, and dashboards.

skills.name: Raw API Calls
skills.description: Calls any Lark Open Platform endpoint directly when no shortcut or API command exists, with dry runs and schema introspection to check it.
